versions.changelog:
- Initial release of "抖音本地生活餐饮运营专家" Agent for Douyin local food businesses
- Supports 6 core modules: 店铺诊断, 爆款菜品, 团购设计, 内容运营, 数据分析, 客服话术
- Provides full-chain operational assistance from store analysis to content planning and data reporting
- Triggered by key phrases related to Douyin operations, group buying, dining marketing, and more
- Offers template commands for common restaurant use cases and outputs actionable reports and plans
